name: Oded
bio: Oded was a prophet of the LORD in Samaria during the reign of King Pekah of Israel. When Pekah's army returned from a devastating war against Judah with 200,000 captive women and children, Oded went out to meet them and rebuked them: the LORD had handed Judah over to them for their own sin, but they had slaughtered them in a rage that reached heaven, and now proposed to enslave their own kinsmen, adding yet more guilt to sins they already carried. He urged them to free the captives before the LORD's fierce anger fell on them. Moved by his words and backed by four leading men of Ephraim, the army released the captives, clothing, feeding, and caring for them before sending them home to Jericho (2 Chronicles 28:9-15). He is a different figure from Oded, father of the prophet Azariah who encouraged King Asa generations earlier.
